purpose: 大白话解释为什么'无探针资金时手续费估算依据是什么', 区分 actual_fee / fee_proxy / heuristic, 并列出从 R0 (proxy) 升级到 R1 (actual) 所需条件.

core_principles.P1_no_actual_fee_in_R0: R0 阶段 (当前) 没有真实 LP tokenId / positionId, 任何 fee 数字都是 proxy / heuristic, 不是 actual fee.
core_principles.P2_proxy_explicit_disclosed: 每个 fee 数字必须显式标注 actual_fee=false / fee_proxy=true / heuristic=true, 不得隐含当作 actual.
core_principles.P3_pool_type_specific_formula: 不同 pool type 的 fee proxy 公式不同 (V3/CLMM 与 DLMM 完全不同), 必须分别定义.
core_principles.P4_range_bin_sensitivity_required: V3/CLMM fee proxy 必须按 range 宽度 (narrow/medium/wide) 分别算; DLMM 必须按 bin coverage 算.
core_principles.P5_stable_pool_il_low_not_zero: stable / LST-stable 池 IL 低, 但 depeg / LST risk 仍要计入.
core_principles.P6_upgrade_path_to_R1_explicit: 从 R0 升级到 R1 (actual fee) 所需数据必须显式列出, 任何 R0 proxy 都不可作为 R1 实际值.

r0_proxy_inputs_required: active_tick_range (current liquidity density around current tick)
window_volume_distribution_by_tick (if available, else skip range sensitivity)
V3_CLMM.in_range_time_ratio_formula: approximated from tick history (if not available, use 0.5 with warning)
V3_CLMM.feeGrowthInside_proxy_note: R0 不读 feeGrowth (需 tokenId, 属于 R1); R0 用 volume × fee_rate × lp_share 估算
V3_CLMM.limitation_disclosure: R0 无法计算: out-of-range 时 IL / 重新 setRange 成本 / 实际累积 feeGrowth / tokensOwed

r0_proxy_inputs_required: window_swap_count_per_bin (if available, else skip bin-level sensitivity)
Meteora_DLMM.medium_bin_fee_proxy_formula: fee_proxy_medium = volume_window × fee_rate × user_bin_share_in_active_bins ± N bins
Meteora_DLMM.sparse_liquidity_warning: 如果 bins_with_liquidity_count < threshold (e.g. 5 per side), 标记 sparse_liquidity_warning=true
Meteora_DLMM.limitation_disclosure: R0 无法计算: bin rebalancing 触发点 / 实际 binShares 累积 / DLMM reward (DLMM 协议层激励, 需 DLMM SDK)

CPMM_v2_cpmm.price_impact_proxy_formula: user_notional / pool_tvl (rough; better: 实际 swap-out 模拟, R0 不做)
CPMM_v2_cpmm.il_proxy_formula: 基于 token ratio change; 简化版 = 2 × sqrt(price_ratio) / (1 + price_ratio) - 1 (Uniswap V2 标准)
CPMM_v2_cpmm.limitation_disclosure: R0 无法计算: 实际 add/remove 滑点 / 时间加权 IL / 多周期 compounding

Stable_LST_Stable.il_proxy_assumption: stable 池 IL 假设低 (e.g. < 0.5%/30d), 但 depeg_risk_score > 0.3 需调高 IL 假设
Stable_LST_Stable.limitation_disclosure: R0 无法计算: 实际 depeg 事件触发 IL / LST 协议层 slashing / 稳定币脱锚后回归时间

future_actual_fee_requirement.description: R0 → R1 升级需要以下数据 (任何缺失 = 仍为 proxy, 不可标记 actual_fee=true):
required_data_points: tokenId / positionId (V3/CLMM NFT mint address; DLMM bin position pubkey)
entry feeGrowthGlobal (V3/CLMM 在 add liquidity 时的 feeGrowthOutside + Inside snapshot)
exit feeGrowthGlobal (V3/CLMM 在 remove/collect 时的 feeGrowthOutside + Inside snapshot)
tokensOwed0 / tokensOwed1 (V3/CLMM mint callback 之后的待 collect 数量)
collected fee (实际 collect 后的 token 数量, 转 USD)
actual add/remove cost (gas + slippage + protocol fee, USD)
realized PnL (collected fee + token 价值变化 - add/remove cost - IL realized)
future_actual_fee_requirement.data_source_r1: 需要真实 LP 操作 (用户签 add/remove/collect) 或 paid indexer (B 线, 需用户单独批准)

in_range_sensitivity_block.fee_estimate_confidence: low (R0 proxy only, 无 actual fee)

in_candidate_block.ev_proxy_confidence: low (per candidate) — explicit per pool, not overall

honest_disclaimers_for_users.D1: R0 阶段所有 fee 数字 = proxy, 不是 actual fee. 实际 fee 必须有 tokenId + feeGrowth snapshot + tokensOwed 实测.
honest_disclaimers_for_users.D2: V3/CLMM range 越窄, fee proxy 越高 (因为 user_lp_share_in_range 越大), 但 out-of-range 风险也越大. R0 不能直接告诉你 range 选多窄最优.
honest_disclaimers_for_users.D3: Meteora DLMM bin coverage 越窄, fee proxy 越高, 但 sparse_liquidity_warning 越严重. R0 不能直接告诉你 bin coverage 选多少最优.
honest_disclaimers_for_users.D4: CPMM fee proxy 精度受限于 TVL / volume 的更新延迟. R0 用的 tvl_proxy / volume_proxy 可能有 ±20% 误差.
honest_disclaimers_for_users.D5: Stable / LST-stable 池 fee proxy 假设 IL 低, 但 depeg 事件可瞬间击穿 IL 假设. R0 depeg_risk_score 是 heuristic, 不是预言机.
honest_disclaimers_for_users.D6: R0 节点报告**不**可用于 B 线 preflight, 因为实际 fee 仍未知. B 线需要 tokenId 实盘数据, 需用户单独批准.
